== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[I'm On The Leader (Japanese)|I'm On The Leader]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67723 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(18, 34, 449, 627)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>141168a661bb62f0a51c3a5d0dc7d048eebadf4d99e08b61aa13c38f4452b090</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
